optimizedContext.value:
# symbol-model

## Rules

### Core Entities
- `FileNode`: `path` (`{workspaceName}:{relativeToCodeRoot}`, forward-slash-normalized, canonical identity), `configRelativePath` (may include `..`; NOT identity), `language`, `contentHash`, `workspace`, optional `embedding: Float32Array` (deferred v2+). Equality by `path`.
- `SpecNode`: `specId` (`workspace:package/topic`), `path`, `title` (from `.specd-metadata.yaml`, default `specId`), `description` (default `""`), `contentHash` (concat artifacts: `spec.md` first, then alphabetically; excludes `.specd-metadata.yaml`), `content` (same ordering), `dependsOn: string[]` (from metadata, default `[]`), `workspace`. Equality by `specId`.
- `SymbolNode`: `id` (`filePath+kind+name+line+column`, deterministic), `name`, `kind: SymbolKind`, `filePath` (workspace-prefixed), 1-based `line`, 0-based `column`, `endLine` (1-based), `endColumn` (0-based exclusive), `selectionRange: SourceRange`, optional `comment`.
- `SourceRange`: 1-based `startLine`/`endLine`, 0-based `startColumn`/exclusive `endColumn`. Construct range non-empty, contains `selectionRange`.
- `DocumentNode`: non-code searchable file (`workspace:path`); `root:` namespace allowed.

### Analysis & State
- Immutable `FileAnalysisDraft` (pre-identity) & `FileAnalysis` (run-local ID, path, language, contentHash, compact facts, optional parser state). Both carry: symbols, imports, binding facts, call facts, namespace context, optional normalized metadata.
- Compact `ParserState` (per-file) & `AdapterSessionState` (run-scoped) — retained only when avoiding deterministic rework. Plain data; NO AST/parser tree/cursor retention after file analysis.
- Run-scoped lookups: file by path/run-local ID, symbol by file+name/qualified name, file↔symbol traversal, specs/documents for cross-entity relations, relation dedup keys. Via `IndexSession`/`SymbolIndex`; common contract across adapters and indexer phases.

### Closed Enums & Relations
- `SymbolKind` (closed): `function`, `class`, `method`, `variable`, `type`, `interface`, `enum`. Adapters map or skip constructs.
- `Relation` value object: `source`, `target`, `type: RelationType`, optional `metadata`. Equality by source+target+type.
- `RelationType`: `IMPORTS` (v1.5, File→File), `DEPENDS_ON` (v1.5, Spec→Spec), `DEFINES`, `EXPORTS` (File→Symbol), `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` (Symbol→Symbol; v2), `COVERS_FILE` (Spec→File), `COVERS_SYMBOL` (Spec→Symbol) (v2+).
- `stale` metadata flag applies ONLY to `COVERS_SYMBOL` (target no longer detectable). Not generic marker.

### Hierarchy
- `EXTENDS`: source type inherits target. `IMPLEMENTS`: source fulfills target contract. `OVERRIDES`: source method replaces/concretizes target method. `OVERRIDES` first-class persisted, not derived.

### Imports
- `ImportDeclaration`: `localName`, `originalName` (empty string for file-only forms), `specifier`, `isRelative`, optional `kind` (`named`|`namespace`|`default`|`side-effect`|`dynamic`|`require`|`blank`; `undefined` ≡ `named`). Pure syntax, no resolution info. Side-effect/dynamic/require/blank imports as file-only, no fake symbols.

### Scoped Bindings & Resolution
- Immutable `readonly` value objects: scope ownership (file/class/method/function/block), binding facts (name/receiver → deterministic target; source kinds: local, parameter, property, class-managed, inherited, file/global, imported type, framework-managed, constructor call, alias), call facts (free/member/static/constructor calls + caller), resolution metadata (deterministic reasons, confidence/diagnostics).
- References use workspace-prefixed paths and symbol IDs.
- Cycle detection on scope traversal (`parentId` links): abort, return no result.
- v1 conservative: NO runtime state, reflection, interprocedural propagation, whole-program data flow.
- Emitted relations: `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE` (typed params/returns/properties/imported annotations), `EXTENDS`/`IMPLEMENTS`/`OVERRIDES`.
- Self-relations (`source === target`) dropped before persistence. Unresolved facts: diagnostics only, no speculative edges.

### Immutability
- All model types immutable, `readonly` props. Graph mutations ONLY via `GraphStore` atomic upserts (whole file-scoped slices). No in-place mutation API.

### Errors
- `SpecdCodeGraphError extends SpecdError` (`@specd/core`) → "Specd Error Contract" (`specd: true`, machine-readable `code`). Specific: `InvalidSymbolKindError`, `InvalidRelationTypeError`, `DuplicateSymbolIdError`, `StoreNotOpenError`.

### Logical Symbols & Canonical Refs
- Logical symbol ≠ declaration occurrence; MAY span multiple declarations (overloads, declaration merge, augmentation). Structured identity: workspace, module/package, declaringOwner, symbol space, simple name, member form + rendered canonical ref. Structured fields authoritative; rendered refs round-trip with escaping, stable across line/column shifts.
- `declaringOwner`: canonical logical identity of owner type/namespace/module/object/receiver/trait/contract. NO parser-node IDs, location-based child/parent, or display-only qualified names. Top-level declarations MAY omit owner.
- Same-name members under different owners → different identities. Moving declaration within same owner → same canonical ref.
- Member forms (methods/properties/getters/setters/constructors/fields/statics/interface members) kept distinct; symbol spaces (type/value/namespace/function/constant) preserved. Language-sensitive normalization — no global lowercasing.
- `SymbolNode.id` + closed `SymbolKind` remain valid; space/member-form additive, MUST NOT overload `SymbolKind`.

### Bindings (public & local)
- Public export slot: looked up by public surface + exported name + symbol space; each proven route has independent binding identity incl. canonical target / ordered re-export provenance. Anonymous/default exports addressable via binding identity.
- Local binding preserves lexical scope + source range. Distinct aliases, shadowed bindings, multiple routes between identical endpoints, competing targets per slot MUST NOT collapse (`Relation` equality ignores metadata).

### Coverage
- Persisted per-file/package coverage: indexed, excluded, unsupported adapter/capability, parse-failed, partial. Includes indexed content hash (absence trustworthiness).

## Constraints
- Value objects — structural equality only (except deterministic `SymbolNode.id`).
- Closed `SymbolKind`, `RelationType` — additions require spec change.
- Runtime dependency: `@specd/core`.
- `FileNode.embedding` deferred v2+ — adapters MUST NOT populate.
- `COVERS_*` deferred v2+ — type exists, not populated by any v1.5/v2 process.
- `DEPENDS_ON` populated in v1.5 from `.specd-metadata.yaml`/`spec.md`.
- `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES` first-class persisted v2 relations.
